_note: Declared by the operator (2026-09-13), by ear, never inferred and never guessed — the same rule as experiments/voiceness_common/vocal_ground_truth.json. `lead_voices` is the number of DISTINCT LEAD VOCALISTS in the song. `extra_speech` marks a song whose vocal stem also carries non-lead speech material (samples, chatter, movie dialogue) that a speaker-clustering model may legitimately separate into its own cluster — so on those songs a k above `lead_voices` is not automatically an error, but a k below it is. A song ABSENT from this map is unscoreable, not zero: the operator flagged that the rest may carry backing vocals, so a wrong inference there would not be representative. Do not add a song to this map from a model's own output.
